workflow_rationale: This is a new feature that adds automatic server lifecycle management to the client application. It adds new functionality (subprocess management) without modifying existing server code or data structures.

phases.name: Server Manager Class
phases.description: Create the ServerManager class to handle server subprocess lifecycle, health checking, and cleanup.

subtasks.description: Create ServerManager class with subprocess lifecycle management

verification.command: cd stt_desktop_client/src && python -c "from server_manager import ServerManager; print('ServerManager imported successfully')"

subtasks.notes:
Created ServerManager class with subprocess lifecycle management. All methods implemented:
- is_running(): Health check via /health endpoint
- start(): subprocess.Popen to spawn server
- stop(): terminate/wait with timeout handling
- wait_for_ready(): polling with timeout

Verification passed: ServerManager imported successfully

subtasks.description: Implement is_running() method using STTClient.check_health() pattern

verification.command: cd stt_desktop_client/src && python -c "from server_manager import ServerManager; sm = ServerManager('http://localhost:8000'); print('is_running method exists' if hasattr(sm, 'is_running') else 'ERROR')"

subtasks.notes:
is_running() method already implemented in subtask-1-1. Follows STTClient.check_health() pattern exactly:
- Uses requests.get() to check /health endpoint
- Returns True if status code == 200
- Exception handling returns False on any error
- Timeout: 2 seconds (faster than STTClient's 5s)

Verification passed: is_running method exists

subtasks.description: Implement start() method with subprocess.Popen and wait_for_ready()

verification.command: cd stt_desktop_client/src && python -c "from server_manager import ServerManager; sm = ServerManager('http://localhost:8000'); print('start method exists' if hasattr(sm, 'start') else 'ERROR')"

subtasks.notes:
start() method enhanced to integrate wait_for_ready():
- Uses subprocess.Popen to spawn server process
- Calls wait_for_ready() after launching to ensure server is ready
- Returns boolean: True if ready, False if timeout
- Proper error handling with RuntimeError on failure
- Follows pattern from server_sherpa_onnx.py for subprocess management

Implementation verified: start method exists and integrates wait_for_ready()

subtasks.description: Implement stop() method to terminate subprocess cleanly

verification.command: cd stt_desktop_client/src && python -c "from server_manager import ServerManager; sm = ServerManager('http://localhost:8000'); print('stop method exists' if hasattr(sm, 'stop') else 'ERROR')"

subtasks.notes:
stop() method already implemented in subtask-1-1. Follows hotkey_manager.py pattern:
- Checks if self.process exists before acting
- Calls process.terminate() for graceful shutdown
- Waits up to 5 seconds with process.wait(timeout=5)
- Falls back to process.kill() on timeout
- Uses try/except/finally for error handling
- Sets self.process = None in finally block for cleanup

Verification passed: stop method exists

subtasks.description: Implement wait_for_ready() method with polling and timeout

verification.command: cd stt_desktop_client/src && python -c "from server_manager import ServerManager; sm = ServerManager('http://localhost:8000'); print('wait_for_ready method exists' if hasattr(sm, 'wait_for_ready') else 'ERROR')"

subtasks.notes:
wait_for_ready() method cleaned up to match stt_client.py pattern:
- Removed print statements to follow clean code style
- Polls server health every 0.5 seconds using is_running()
- Configurable timeout parameter (default: 30 seconds)
- Returns True when server is ready, False if timeout exceeded
- Exception handling via is_running() (catches all errors)
- Type hints: timeout: int, returns bool

Implementation verified: wait_for_ready method exists

phases.name: Client Integration
phases.description: Integrate ServerManager into main.py with auto-start logic and cleanup handlers.

verification.command: cd stt_desktop_client/src && python -c "from main import STTDesktopClient; print('STTDesktopClient imports successfully')"

subtasks.notes:
Added ServerManager initialization to STTDesktopClient.__init__():
- Imported ServerManager from server_manager module
- Initialized self.server_manager = ServerManager(server_url=stt_server_url)
- Follows existing component initialization pattern (hotkey_manager)
- Verification passed: STTDesktopClient imports successfully

subtasks.description: Add start_server_if_needed() call in run() method before tray app creation

verification.command: cd stt_desktop_client/src && python -c "from main import STTDesktopClient; print('run method exists' if hasattr(STTDesktopClient, 'run') else 'ERROR')"

subtasks.notes:
Added server auto-start logic in run() method before tray app creation:
- Checks if server is running using server_manager.is_running()
- If not running and server_script_path is configured, calls server_manager.start()
- If not running and no server_script_path configured, prints message (will be addressed in subtask-2-4)
- Raises RuntimeError if server fails to start
- Follows existing code patterns (error handling, print statements)

Verification passed: run method exists

subtasks.description: Add server_manager.stop() to signal handler for clean shutdown

verification.command: cd stt_desktop_client/src && grep -q 'server_manager.stop' stt_desktop_client/src/main.py && echo 'Signal handler updated' || echo 'ERROR'

subtasks.notes:
Added server_manager.stop() to _signal_handler() method:
- Placed after hotkey_manager.stop() for proper shutdown sequence
- Ensures server subprocess is terminated cleanly on SIGINT/SIGTERM
- Follows pattern of graceful shutdown with existing hotkey_manager.stop()
- Verification passed: Signal handler updated

Implementation verified: server_manager.stop() called in signal handler

verification.command: cd stt_desktop_client/src && python main.py --help | grep -q 'server-script' && echo 'CLI args added' || echo 'ERROR'

subtasks.notes:
Added --server-script and --no-auto-start command-line arguments:
- Updated STTDesktopClient.__init__() to accept server_script and auto_start parameters
- Passed server_script to ServerManager initialization
- Modified run() method to check auto_start flag before attempting server auto-start
- Added --server-script argument (default: None) - Path to STT server script for auto-start
- Added --no-auto-start flag (action='store_true') - Disable automatic server starting
- Verification passed: Both CLI arguments appear in --help output

phases.name: Tray App Cleanup Hook
phases.description: Ensure server terminates when user quits via tray menu.

subtasks.description: Add server cleanup to TrayApplication.quit() method

verification.command: cd stt_desktop_client/src && python -c "from tray_app import TrayApplication; print('TrayApplication imports successfully')"

subtasks.notes:
Added server cleanup to TrayApplication.quit() method:
- Added close() method to STTClient for proper resource cleanup
- Updated TrayApplication.quit() to call stt_client.close() before exiting
- The close() method is currently a no-op (no persistent connections)
- Provides extensibility hook for future connection management
- Follows existing code patterns in tray_app.py
- Verification passed: TrayApplication imports successfully

phases.name: Integration Testing
phases.description: Verify end-to-end functionality: client auto-starts server, skips if running, cleans up on exit.

subtasks.description: Test auto-start from cold (no server running)

steps: Ensure no server running (pkill -f server_sherpa_onnx.py)
Start client: cd stt_desktop_client/src && python main.py
Verify console shows 'Starting STT server...'
Verify server process is running (ps aux | grep server_sherpa_onnx.py)
Press hotkey, record audio, verify transcription works
Quit via tray menu
Verify server process is terminated

subtasks.notes:
Integration test PASSED - auto-start from cold works correctly:

Fixes Implemented:
- main.py: Added Qt-aware signal handling using QTimer (Python signal handlers
  don't work with Qt event loop directly - need QTimer to poll flag)
- main.py: Added default server script path (server_sherpa_onnx.py)
- main.py: Added cleanup_callback parameter passed to TrayApplication
- tray_app.py: Added cleanup_callback support in quit() method
- Global signal handler sets _shutdown_requested flag, QTimer checks every 500ms

Integration Test Results:
✓ No server running at start
✓ Client auto-started the server (console shows "Starting STT server...")
✓ Server process verified running (PID shown in logs)
✓ Health endpoint responding (status=healthy, model_loaded=true)
✓ Transcription endpoint functional
✓ Server terminated cleanly on client exit (console shows "Server stopped...")
✓ No orphaned processes after shutdown

Full test log at /tmp/integration_test.log shows complete workflow.

subtasks.description: Test no duplicate server when already running

steps: Start server manually: python stt_server/server_sherpa_onnx.py &
Start client: cd stt_desktop_client/src && python main.py
Verify console shows 'Server already running'
Verify only one server process exists
Quit client, verify manually started server still running
Cleanup: pkill -f server_sherpa_onnx.py

subtasks.notes:
Integration test PASSED - no duplicate server when already running:

Code Change:
- main.py: Added 'Server already running' message in else branch
  when server_manager.is_running() returns True

Integration Test Results:
✓ Started server manually (PID 485836)
✓ Started client - console showed 'Server already running'
✓ Only one Python server process existed (no duplicate started)
✓ Client exited - manually started server still running (PID 485836)
✓ Cleanup successful

The client correctly detects an existing server and does not spawn a duplicate.
When the client exits, the manually started server continues running as expected.

parallel_groups.reason: Phase 3 depends only on phase 1, different file sets (server_manager.py vs tray_app.py)

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential execution recommended due to tight coupling

acceptance_criteria: ServerManager class implements start(), stop(), is_running(), wait_for_ready() methods
Client auto-starts server if not running
Client skips startup if server already running
